charge_port.notes: electrive: the Charger Daytona 2024-2026 needs the Free2move Charge NACS-CCS1 adapter for Superchargers, which implies a CCS1 inlet; MoparInsiders plugged the adapter into the "CCS charging port" of a 2025 Scat Pack. (The Mopar 2026 handbook J1772-inlet sentence could not be read here, so it is not cited.)

supercharger_access.notes: Stellantis (March 2026): Charger Daytona 2024-2026 can use Tesla Superchargers with the Free2move Charge NACS-CCS1 adapter. Reports say "North America"; Canada implied, not separately confirmed. Canada: the reports say "North America"; no source confirms Canadian cars are covered.

wheels.notes: Performance Handling Group ($3,495): 20x11 aluminum wheels, 305/35ZR20; the page does not say which trims can add it.
